description: This file manages memory runtime plugins within the openclaw project. It includes functions to ensure memory runtime, retrieve active memory search managers, resolve backend configurations, and close search managers, working with configuration objects, plugin registry, and memory state.

methods.name: function ensureMemoryRuntime(cfg?: OpenClawConfig) { ensureMemoryRuntime
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves the current memory runtime, optionally based on provided configuration, and applies auto-enabling plugin logic if necessary.

methods.name: export async function getActiveMemorySearchManager(params: { getActiveMemorySearchManager
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the memory search manager associated with the runtime, based on provided configuration, agent ID, and purpose.

methods.name: export function resolveActiveMemoryBackendConfig(params: { cfg: OpenClawConfig; agentId: string / resolveActiveMemoryBackendConfig
methods.description: Resolves and returns the memory backend configuration for given parameters, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: export async function closeActiveMemorySearchManagers(cfg?: OpenClawConfig): Promise<void> { closeActiveMemorySearchManagers
methods.description: Closes all active memory search managers for an optional configuration.
